summary: This note reports the death of Pao Sarasin, who died at Siriraj Hospital in Bangkok on March 7, 2013, at age 83 after a month-long hospitalization for a blood infection. It describes a royal bathing rite ceremony held in his honor at Wat Benchamabophit, attended by Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn representing the royal family. It also notes his survivors, including his wife and three sons.
one_line: Obituary-style note on the death of Pao Sarasin in Bangkok in 2013, including his royal bathing rite and survivors.
key_facts: Pao Sarasin died at Siriraj Hospital in Bangkok on March 7, 2013.
Pao Sarasin died at the age of 83.
Pao Sarasin had been hospitalized for a month-long stay for a blood infection before his death.
A royal bathing rite ceremony for Pao Sarasin was held at Wat Benchamabophit.
Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn attended the royal bathing rite ceremony for Pao Sarasin, representing the royal family.
Pao Sarasin was survived by his wife, Thapuying Tawika Sarasin.
Pao Sarasin was survived by three sons.
One of Pao Sarasin's sons is Kanit Sarasin, a Thai television host.
